thread:
rachel: FYI onboarding sample that imports subpaths from @redwood/sdk-js is failing in Bun and Deno deploys. Seen across sample-apps and nextjs-edge templates. :grimacing:

jake: odd, what import pattern do the samples use?

rachel: something like `import sdk from '@redwood/sdk-js/edge'` or `import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk-js/client'`. After the exports change yesterday those subpaths 404 during resolution in a few runtimes.

priya: can you paste the current `exports` snippet?

rachel: sure:

```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs"
  },
  "./client": "./dist/esm/client/index.mjs",
  "./edge": "./dist/esm/edge.mjs",
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```

jake: hm, removing a wildcard or changing subpath shapes can break older bundlers that expect a `./` fallback. Some engines (bun, deno:deploy) still resolve by simple string matching and can't map the subpath to the provided file. They then hit the `main` field which is CJS -> runtime error in ESM-only contexts.

priya: also buried in the issue: types drift. TS consumers who import `@redwood/sdk-js/edge` get no typings because `types` still points to the top-level `dist/index.d.ts` and we didn't generate per-subpath `.d.ts` files. So compile-time errors for customers.

ci-bot: CI: sample-apps-edge 0/144 failing imports/resolution. See: https://ci.redwood.ai/flow/4521

rachel: stacktrace from a reproducible run (Cloudflare worker): `Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'` when running the bundled artifact.

jake: mitigation options:
- re-introduce a `./` index export that maps to the ESM entry so naive resolvers get the right thing
- add a "browser" field and `module` field as a compatibility shim for bundlers that prefer those entries
- generate per-subpath d.ts and add `exports.types` mapping (TypeScript 4.7+ supports this)
- publish patch with "import"/"require" and explicit "default" fallback to ESM for edge tip

priya: we should also update the SDK samples to avoid subpath imports until we stabilize the exports map - short-term patch.

rachel: agree. For the long term we need: per-subpath type stubs, CI job that verifies resolution across bun/deno/cloudflare, and docs section about `exports` and bundler quirks.

jake: PR opened to add a compatibility index + types mapping: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-js/pull/2401. Includes a tiny repro and a new `test:resolve-edge` CI job using esbuild + bun runtime.

rachel: can we also add a smoke test in onboarding flow that installs the SDK in a fresh project and runs `tsc --noEmit`? That caught typing regressions before.

ci-bot: NOTE: rollbacks will impact consumers. Current plan is to publish 1.8.1 patch with compatibility shims and merge PR after QA.

deploy-bot: Published `@redwood/sdk-js@1.8.1-compat` to npm for smoke tests.

priya: I'll add the types generation to the build pipeline and wire `exports.types` to per-subpath entries. Also drafting the doc blurb for GETTING_STARTED.md.

rachel: thanks. Assigning owners: jake -> compatibility shim + CI, priya -> types + docs, rachel -> sample updates and release testing.

jake: will follow up with a short note to engineering-announce once stable. :white_check_mark:
